en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 「你吩咐以色列人转回，安营在比·哈希录前，密夺和海的中间，对着巴力· 洗分，靠近海边安营。

zhTraditional.text: 「你吩咐以色列人轉回，安營在比‧哈希錄前，密奪和海的中間，對着巴力‧洗分，靠近海邊安營。

en.text: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’

zhSimplified.text: 法老必说：『以色列人在地中绕迷了，旷野把他们困住了。』

zhTraditional.text: 法老必說：『以色列人在地中繞迷了，曠野把他們困住了。』

en.text: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD.” They did so.

zhSimplified.text: 我要使法老的心刚硬，他要追赶他们，我便在法老和他全军身上得荣耀；埃及人就知道我是耶和华。」于是以色列人这样行了。

zhTraditional.text: 我要使法老的心剛硬，他要追趕他們，我便在法老和他全軍身上得榮耀；埃及人就知道我是耶和華。」於是以色列人這樣行了。

en.text: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”

zhSimplified.text: 有人告诉埃及王说：「百姓逃跑。」法老和他的臣仆就向百姓变心，说：「我们容以色列人去，不再服事我们，这做的是什么事呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 有人告訴埃及王說：「百姓逃跑。」法老和他的臣僕就向百姓變心，說：「我們容以色列人去，不再服事我們，這做的是甚麼事呢？」

en.text: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;

zhSimplified.text: 法老就预备他的车辆，带领军兵同去，

zhTraditional.text: 法老就預備他的車輛，帶領軍兵同去，

en.text: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

zhSimplified.text: 并带着六百辆特选的车和埃及所有的车，每辆都有车兵长。

zhTraditional.text: 並帶着六百輛特選的車和埃及所有的車，每輛都有車兵長。

en.text: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使埃及王法老的心刚硬，他就追赶以色列人，因为以色列人是昂然无惧地出埃及。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使埃及王法老的心剛硬，他就追趕以色列人，因為以色列人是昂然無懼地出埃及。

en.text: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及人追赶他们，法老一切的马匹、车辆、马兵，与军兵就在海边上，靠近比·哈希录，对着巴力·洗分，在他们安营的地方追上了。

zhTraditional.text: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛、馬兵，與軍兵就在海邊上，靠近比‧哈希錄，對着巴力‧洗分，在他們安營的地方追上了。

en.text: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 法老临近的时候，以色列人举目看见埃及人赶来，就甚惧怕，向耶和华哀求。

zhTraditional.text: 法老臨近的時候，以色列人舉目看見埃及人趕來，就甚懼怕，向耶和華哀求。

en.text: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?

zhSimplified.text: 他们对摩西说：「难道在埃及没有坟地，你把我们带来死在旷野吗？你为什么这样待我们，将我们从埃及领出来呢？

zhTraditional.text: 他們對摩西說：「難道在埃及沒有墳地，你把我們帶來死在曠野嗎？你為甚麼這樣待我們，將我們從埃及領出來呢？

en.text: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”

zhSimplified.text: 我们在埃及岂没有对你说过，不要搅扰我们，容我们服事埃及人吗？因为服事埃及人比死在旷野还好。」

zhTraditional.text: 我們在埃及豈沒有對你說過，不要攪擾我們，容我們服事埃及人嗎？因為服事埃及人比死在曠野還好。」

en.text: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西对百姓说：「不要惧怕，只管站住！看耶和华今天向你们所要施行的救恩。因为，你们今天所看见的埃及人必永远不再看见了。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西對百姓說：「不要懼怕，只管站住！看耶和華今天向你們所要施行的救恩。因為，你們今天所看見的埃及人必永遠不再看見了。

en.text: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必为你们争战；你们只管静默，不要作声。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必為你們爭戰；你們只管靜默，不要作聲。」

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你为什么向我哀求呢？你吩咐以色列人往前走。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你為甚麼向我哀求呢？你吩咐以色列人往前走。

en.text: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.

zhSimplified.text: 你举手向海伸杖，把水分开。以色列人要下海中走干地。

zhTraditional.text: 你舉手向海伸杖，把水分開。以色列人要下海中走乾地。

en.text: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

zhSimplified.text: 我要使埃及人的心刚硬，他们就跟着下去。我要在法老和他的全军、车辆、马兵上得荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 我要使埃及人的心剛硬，他們就跟着下去。我要在法老和他的全軍、車輛、馬兵上得榮耀。

en.text: The Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”

zhSimplified.text: 我在法老和他的车辆、马兵上得荣耀的时候，埃及人就知道我是耶和华了。」

zhTraditional.text: 我在法老和他的車輛、馬兵上得榮耀的時候，埃及人就知道我是耶和華了。」

en.text: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

zhSimplified.text: 在以色列营前行走 神的使者，转到他们后边去；云柱也从他们前边转到他们后边立住。

zhTraditional.text: 在以色列營前行走上帝的使者，轉到他們後邊去；雲柱也從他們前邊轉到他們後邊立住。

en.text: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.

zhSimplified.text: 在埃及营和以色列营中间有云柱，一边黑暗，一边发光，终夜两下不得相近。

zhTraditional.text: 在埃及營和以色列營中間有雲柱，一邊黑暗，一邊發光，終夜兩下不得相近。

en.text: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西向海伸杖，耶和华便用大东风，使海水一夜退去，水便分开，海就成了干地。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西向海伸杖，耶和華便用大東風，使海水一夜退去，水便分開，海就成了乾地。

en.text: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人下海中走干地，水在他们的左右作了墙垣。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人下海中走乾地，水在他們的左右作了牆垣。

en.text: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及人追赶他们，法老一切的马匹、车辆，和马兵都跟着下到海中。

zhTraditional.text: 埃及人追趕他們，法老一切的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵都跟着下到海中。

en.text: In the morning watch, the LORD looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.

zhSimplified.text: 到了晨更的时候，耶和华从云火柱中向埃及的军兵观看，使埃及的军兵混乱了；

zhTraditional.text: 到了晨更的時候，耶和華從雲火柱中向埃及的軍兵觀看，使埃及的軍兵混亂了；

en.text: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians!”

zhSimplified.text: 又使他们的车轮脱落，难以行走，以致埃及人说：「我们从以色列人面前逃跑吧！因耶和华为他们攻击我们了。」

zhTraditional.text: 又使他們的車輪脫落，難以行走，以致埃及人說：「我們從以色列人面前逃跑吧！因耶和華為他們攻擊我們了。」

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你向海伸杖，叫水仍合在埃及人并他们的车辆、马兵身上。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你向海伸杖，叫水仍合在埃及人並他們的車輛、馬兵身上。」

en.text: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. The LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西就向海伸杖，到了天一亮，海水仍旧复原。埃及人避水逃跑的时候，耶和华把他们推翻在海中，

zhTraditional.text: 摩西就向海伸杖，到了天一亮，海水仍舊復原。埃及人避水逃跑的時候，耶和華把他們推翻在海中，

en.text: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.

zhSimplified.text: 水就回流，淹没了车辆和马兵。那些跟着以色列人下海法老的全军，连一个也没有剩下。

zhTraditional.text: 水就回流，淹沒了車輛和馬兵。那些跟着以色列人下海法老的全軍，連一個也沒有剩下。

en.text: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人却在海中走干地；水在他们的左右作了墙垣。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人卻在海中走乾地；水在他們的左右作了牆垣。

en.text: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.

zhSimplified.text: 当日，耶和华这样拯救以色列人脱离埃及人的手，以色列人看见埃及人的死尸都在海边了。

zhTraditional.text: 當日，耶和華這樣拯救以色列人脫離埃及人的手，以色列人看見埃及人的死屍都在海邊了。

en.text: Israel saw the great work which the LORD did to the Egyptians, and the people feared the LORD; and they believed in the LORD and in his servant Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人看见耶和华向埃及人所行的大事，就敬畏耶和华，又信服他和他的仆人摩西。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人看見耶和華向埃及人所行的大事，就敬畏耶和華，又信服他和他的僕人摩西。
